v3.0.1-camcorder ● GitHub Actions APK CI Ready OpenGL ES 3.0 + CameraX

AnalogTV 3.0 Camcorder for Android

Open-source native Android VHS Camcorder & Composite Television Simulator inspired by Alastair Bor's AnalogTV 3.0 engine. Streams live CameraX frames through a 9-stage OpenGL ES 3.0 composite/tape shader and records hardware-encoded MP4 video with real-time VHS microphone tape wear.

1. LIVE CAMERAX + GLSL ES 3.0 📷

Zero-Copy Dual-Surface Recording

LiveCamcorderGlRenderer.kt binds the camera's GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES stream at 60 fps, runs a ping-pong FBO for Vidicon tube comet lag, and renders simultaneously to the screen viewfinder and a hardware MediaCodec H.264 encoder surface.

2. MICROPHONE TAPE WEAR DSP 🎙️

Real-Time Capstan Wow/Flutter & Hiss

AnalogAudioTapeRecorder.kt processes live camcorder microphone PCM samples through a fractional delay line modulated at 1.4 Hz (wow) and 6.5 Hz (flutter), 1-pole VHS linear track low-pass filter, and 50/60 Hz mains intercarrier buzz.

3. GITHUB ACTIONS APK CI/CD ⚙️

Automated Cloud APK & Pages Deploy

Push analog_tv_android_studio.zip to any GitHub repo: .github/workflows/build-apk.yml automatically compiles AnalogTV-Camcorder-v3.0-debug.apk on Ubuntu JDK 17 + Android SDK 34 and attaches it to GitHub Releases.

Use on Android (Instant PWA + Native Kotlin Project)

        

        
      

      

        

          
1. Instant Android Web App (Works Right Now)

          
Tap Open Video / Photo to load any video from your phone's gallery, choose a 1-tap Look (like Home Movie VHS or Night Tram Vidicon), and tap Convert / Rec Video to record and download the processed analog video directly to your device.

        

        

          
2. Native Android Studio Project (Kotlin + OpenGL ES 3.0 + Media3)

          
A complete native Android Studio project (analog_tv_android_studio.zip) has also been generated for you. It includes the OpenGL ES 3.0 composite/VHS GLSL fragment shader (analog_vhs_fragment.glsl), Jetpack Compose UI, and androidx.media3:media3-transformer hardware-accelerated MP4 converter.
